Under the terms of the agreement, Banner will acquire Pacific Financial in an all-stock transaction, subject to the terms and conditions set forth therein. Following closing, the combined company is expected to have approximately $18 billion in assets. Bank of the Pacific is a 55-year-old Washington state-chartered commercial bank serving business and consumer clients at 18 branches and offices in Western Washington and Northern Oregon. At March 31, 2026, Bank of the Pacific had assets of $1.29 billion, a high-quality loan portfolio of $762 million, and a low-cost deposit base of $1.14 billion.
